The following builds are provided by the community, and pulled from other locations as they are made available. The builds are sorted by the minimum number of slots used. Base DPS range is the approximate range of damage, using the maximum DPS, as well as the DPS when the wand is low on mana. This is applied to a training dummy on the testing grounds, using the original set with a Standardization wand. Please remember that all builds can be further enhanced by adding more/stronger spells and effects, and that these builds are the baseline before any further modifiers are added. Effects/Notes are for any special notes to understand or further enhance the build.
